hypothesis: Lower-degree transforms and spatial-deletion stability reduce unreliable projective extrapolation at useful coverage.
matching: Reuse the exact per-region, hash-verified cached correspondences and v1 edge proposal split. No feature extraction or new hidden-pixel access.
control: Replay stored joint homography poses with identical audits, adding mandatory convergence rejection. Confirm original policy counts whenever that solver converged.

stability.method: delete each occupied world-space block from all training edges simultaneously
stability.blocks: 2 transverse x 4 longitudinal within target frame, outer coordinates clipped
stability.interpretation: sensitivity estimate, not a calibrated confidence interval

acceptance: Mandatory convergence; otherwise preserve original correspondence, spatial hull, positive-transform, photometric audit and fusion policy thresholds. Never expand support.
evaluation: Same original hidden masks and Telea same-pixel control. Equal-road and pooled summaries plus same-pixel comparisons. These are development roads.
limitations: Affine and similarity are geometric approximations, not calibrated metric poses
Deleted blocks and pixels are correlated
No independently held-out route is tuned or scored in this run
